scene.speaker: sofia
scene.bubble: Erik built a clock that barks the hours. Luna is confused. The neighbours too.
scene.intro: Erik built a clock that barks the hours, and Luna is very confused: at three o'clock she answers three times. What time is it? Half past eight — time for school. What time is the film? At seven o'clock in the evening. Sofía prefers her old watch, which is quiet and always right. What time do you get up? Look at the clock and say it in English!

activities.title: Listen to Erik's barking clock day. Write a time or word in each gap.

data.script: Erik: My new invention: the barking clock! At seven o'clock it barks seven times. … Sofia: And Luna answered every bark. Fourteen barks in total! … Erik: At half past twelve it barks for lunch. … Sofia: The neighbour thought there were two dogs in the house. … Erik: At four o'clock, play time bark. At nine, bedtime bark. … Sofia: And at midnight? … Erik: At midnight it's silent. Even barking clocks must sleep. … Sofia: Your best invention… and the noisiest!
